name: secret_get
description: Retrieve a secret (database password, API key, OAuth token, certificate, etc.) from z-mist. The secret is stored AES-256 encrypted in MySQL and the encrypted value is returned in the response (server-side decryption is not exposed by default for safety; use the plainValue-returning variant by combining with z-ctc audit if you need the decrypted form). Backed by GET /api/secret/get. Note: every call can be recorded in z_mist_secret_access_log (FEATURE021 recordAccess). Requires the caller to be authenticated via z-ctc SSO. ZMistApplication runs on port 8080 (see z-mist-admin/src/main/resources/application.yml).

secretKey.description: Unique key identifier within (group, namespace). Example: 'db_password', 'openai_api_key', 'wechat_app_secret'.

group.description: Logical group, e.g. 'database', 'ai', 'payment', 'oauth'. Use to partition secrets by service category. Defaults to 'DEFAULT_GROUP' if omitted.

namespace.description: Environment namespace. Common values: 'dev', 'staging', 'prod'. Same secretKey in different namespaces returns different values. Defaults to empty string ('') if omitted.
